# Report templates

Drop the official templates for the five inspection returns here, one file each, and the Reports screens will be reconciled against them:

| Report | Expected template | Screen |
|---|---|---|
| ASP biennial report figures | Scottish Government biennial report guidance and the ASP National Minimum Dataset indicator list | `/reports/asp` |
| Child Protection Register statistics | Children's Social Work Statistics: child protection return specification | `/reports/cp` |
| MARAC SafeLives return | SafeLives MARAC data template workbook (quarterly) | `/reports/marac` |
| MAPPA annual report counts | MAPPA annual report table set (Scottish Government overview report appendix) | `/reports/mappa` |
| AWI application timeliness | Mental Welfare Commission AWI monitoring return and Office of the Public Guardian guardianship performance measures | `/reports/awi` |

Until the templates are here, each report's meta line says "Field set to verify against the current template" and `docs/RESEARCH.md` section 5 records what the field sets were built from. Reconciliation means: matching every template column to a computed figure or a documented gap, removing anything the template does not ask for, and taking the "to verify" marker off that report.
